'''Reti''' was an overly talkative [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] mechanic who operated during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="SF" /> He later joined the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], under the leadership of the pirate chief [[Nym/Legends|Nym]].<ref name="JSF1">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] Mission 1: The Informant</ref>

==Biography==
{{Quote|Reti, have you ever considered a career in piracy?''"<br />"''Is that a job offer? I don't work cheap you know!|Nym and Reti|<ref name="SF" />}}
Reti made his living as a [[Scavenger/Legends|salvage]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], flying his personal vessel, the ''[[Zoomer]]'', in and around the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Karthakk system]]s. Reti was known for his motor-mouth,<ref name="SF" /> and liked to brag that he downed sixteen [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="JSF1" /> In reality, Reti was a skittish and cowardly creature, though was an able fighter pilot at the controls of the ''Zoomer''. Reti had a number of contacts across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including the mercenary [[Vana Sage]] and a particularly ornery Toydarian [[Watto/Legends|junk dealer]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="JSF3">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] Mission 3: Prison Break</ref> At some point in his past, Reti operated as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] on [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]].<ref name="JSF1" />

Reti assisted the [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]] pilot [[Rhys Dallows]] prior to the Battle of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] when the young cadet's starfighter was damaged by a mercenary squadron in the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]]. Reti towed Dallows' fighter to Vana Sage's outpost, and later accompanied the pilots during sorties against forces of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. He also flew alongside Nym, and fell in with his Revenants following the Battle of Naboo.<ref name="SF" />

For the next ten years, Reti continued to ply his trade, and remained in contact with Nym, whom Reti counted as an old friend; at one point, Nym had to bail Reti out when the Toydarian ran into a "nasty group of mercenaries" known as the [[Sabaoth Squadron/Legends|Sabaoth Squadron]]. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] arranged a meeting with Nym to discuss Trade Federation activity in the Karthakk system, Reti was sent to meet the Jedi in the [[Ruby Nebula]]. Unfortunately, and despite Reti's protests to the contrary, the salvager was tailed by a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|Trade Federation landing craft]], though Jedi and Toydarian worked together to destroy the vessel.<ref name="JSF1" /> Reti led Gallia to Nym on [[Maramere]], and&mdash;despite his boss's reservations about the presence of a Jedi&mdash;about both helped the pirate liberate his troops from the infamous [[Spacestation 1138]].<ref name="JSF3" />

Reti accompanied Adi Gallia on several more missions, culminating in an assault against the fortified world of [[Nod Kartha]], home of a large [[trihexalon]] factory. Nym's forces were ambushed by the [[Sabaoth Squadron/Legends|Sabaoth Squadron]], but worse, the deadly [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] to claim a bounty on Reti's head. Dodging laser blasts, Reti had no choice but to fire his hyperdrive in a wild jump to flee the relentless [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. His colleagues could do nothing to help, and remained unaware of Reti's final destination.<ref name="JSF">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] Mission 7: Hammer and Anvil</ref>

Following the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], in which Nym's forces battled [[Cavik Toth]]'s fleet above the planet, Vana Sage embarked on a mission to locate Reti&mdash;or learn whatever fate had befallen the hapless Toydarian.<ref name="JSF15">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] Mission 15: The Jedi Master</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Reti was able to read and write in both [[Toydarian (language)/Legends|Toydarian]] and [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]]. He could also speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], Huttese, [[Pak Pak/Legends|Pak Pak]], [[Twi'leki/Legends|Ryl]], and Toydarian.<ref name="WizardsCite-Meet Reti, Salvage Pilot">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20011115c_reti&c=rpg|text=Meet Reti, Salvage Pilot}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Reti was voiced in both [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] and ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]'' by [[Wally Wingert]].

In the Prison Break mission of ''Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter'', upon destroying several frigates, Reti comments that a "Toydarian on Tatooine" would "pay good credits for this junk." This is apparently intended as a reference to Watto, though as [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] shows, Watto refuses to deal in Republic credits. However, Reti's use of the term "credits" could be a slang, generic term for currency, much like the real-world term "cash," which can refer to money in any form.
